decision: I chose a conservative sample policy: single HTTP POST attempt to the webhook and log failures (no durable retry queue).
alternatives: Single attempt then log failures
Retry webhook delivery with exponential backoff and persist attempts

evidence: readiness_report noted webhook retry policy unspecified; no skill prescribes it.

decision: I chose to define indexes in the Mongoose schemas (schema.index) and run ensureIndexes on connection; also verify via the documentdb MCP server.
